notes: This is al-Saduq's statement of his routes (طرق) to Hammad b. Isa's book, with no saying, so it is a ruling case (rule 11). Three routes are read as three groups, each written as the text gives it.
Route 2 («و يعقوب بن يزيد، عن حماد») has no «أبي» before Ya'qub in the text, so none is added.
